nrem_evidence: Low-frequency optogenetic activation increases NREM; photoinhibition decreases NREM.
other_states: Low-frequency optogenetic manipulation did not change REM amounts; chemogenetic activation also reduces REM and induces hypothermia; high-frequency stimulation may induce depolarization block/arousal.
interpretation: Projection into VLPO is regional anatomical signal; postsynaptic Gal/GABA identity, synapses and NREM effect are unmeasured.

nrem_evidence: Vgat activation reduces NREM latency and increases NREM; ablation reduces daytime NREM and changes sleep-pressure requirements. Rat GABA/Fos correlates with sleep pressure.
other_states: Vgat activation also reduces REM. Vglut2 population has different stress/allostatic functions. Do not claim homeostatic rebound abolished.
interpretation: Literature MnPO/MnPN maps to Allen acronym MEPO, not a separately invented MnPO ontology node. Whole MEPO signal cannot identify Vgat cells.

nrem_evidence: Bilateral chemogenetic activation/inhibition regulates NREM at specified Zeitgeber times; sleep-pressure-associated cells inhibit wake-active lateral hypothalamic neurons.
other_states: 2017 study also regulates REM; unilateral low-frequency optogenetic study increases REM without changing NREM or wake. NREM-specificity is not established.
interpretation: ZI includes functional and molecular heterogeneity; whole ZI projection is neither Lhx6 targeting nor selectively NREM-promoting.

functional_celltype: SOM/Sst-positive GABAergic neurons within caudal basal forebrain
nrem_evidence: Xu 2015 optogenetic activation of caudal BF SOM neurons increases wake-to-NREM transition probability.
other_states: Only a subset is NREM-active. Anaclet 2018 activation/inhibition showed no appreciable acute NREM or wake promotion, with limited context-dependent arousal influence. Cholinergic/Vglut2/PV BF cells can promote wake.
interpretation: SI is one anatomical component of the manipulated caudal BF; its bulk projection signal cannot resolve SOM targeting and does not establish SI as uniformly NREM-promoting.

requested_region: Magnocellular preoptic region in caudal BF experiments
functional_celltype: SOM/Sst-positive GABAergic neurons within manipulated caudal BF
nrem_evidence: Caudal BF manipulation includes magnocellular preoptic nucleus in literature; the atlas node is Magnocellular nucleus, not an exact MCPO-labelled node.
other_states: No separately isolated MA-specific NREM effect demonstrated by cited experiments.
interpretation: Report MA only as optional anatomical context; MCPO-to-MA boundary correspondence requires registration/histology. Do not treat as validated NREM-promoting core or a surrogate for PZ.

requested_region: Horizontal limb of diagonal band in caudal BF experiments
functional_celltype: SOM/Sst-positive GABAergic neurons in manipulated horizontal diagonal band
nrem_evidence: Caudal BF manipulation includes horizontal diagonal band; source paper explicitly excludes rostral medial septum and vertical diagonal band.
other_states: Atlas NDB is not a celltype-specific or horizontal-limb-specific target.
interpretation: Report NDB separately as optional anatomical context; whole NDB should not be equated with manipulated HDB or core sleep-promoting tissue.

functional_celltype: Sector-specific inhibitory thalamic reticular neurons; CaV3.3-dependent bursting populations
nrem_evidence: CaV3.3 perturbation and sensory-sector hyperpolarization alter local spindle/delta composition during NREM.
other_states: Local NREM rhythms and global sleep amount/onset are different endpoints; do not infer universal NREM induction.
interpretation: Allen acronym RT is the thalamic reticular nucleus. Allen TRN id574 is Tegmental reticular nucleus and is explicitly excluded.

functional_celltype: Sleep-active inhibitory/VGAT neurons; experimentally targeted GABAergic PZ cells
nrem_evidence: PZ lesions/transmission disruption reduce SWS; selective GABA-cell activation potently induces SWS and EEG slow-wave activity.
other_states: Lesion vs transmission-disruption REM effects differ; 2014 authors warn against assigning a REM-specific role. VGAT includes GABA/glycine inhibitory transmission.
interpretation: Not evaluable with a preassigned exact unionize ID. Do not substitute PGRN, other nearby reticular labels, or Allen TRN. Future custom voxel ROI needs histological registration.
